summary: Red-phase test-writing run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Committed (1) new GeneratedClientTests.swift exercising the planned ColorMatchingAPI generated client against a local stub ClientTransport for all six surfaces the app uses, (2) rewritten APIClientTests.swift pinning the app wrapper's generated-type surface and the spec-conformant wire behavior (200+JSON upload responses, spec-typed measurement/judgment payloads, bearer auth, patch-id format 'pair#side'), and (3) docs/color-matching-openapi-delta.md recording 16 verified contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published /api/v1 OpenAPI spec (viamin/color_matching#113, merged), the codegen normalization rule, refresh workflow, and the criterion-to-test mapping. The Swift tests are intentionally red: they cannot compile until the implementation adds the ColorMatchingAPI target (swift-openapi-generator + vendored spec) and rewires APIClient. No Swift toolchain exists in this container (command -v swift fails), so swift test --disable-sandbox could not be executed here; it runs in the repo's macOS CI.
